source: Observed Japanese Options and GolfStudio correction history through 2026-08-22

failures.symptom: A screenshot remains visible beneath transparent controls, so elements cannot be moved or reused independently.
failures.remediation: Replace the screenshot with a Clean Plate and independent Editable Elements; fail if the reference is requested by runtime code.
failures.acceptance_gate: The completed runtime never loads the Reference Screen and remains coherent when any component is hidden or moved.

failures.symptom: Several labels, controls, or states are baked into one raster object.
failures.remediation: Split the raster at semantic and state boundaries; keep shared alignment in a component root.
failures.acceptance_gate: Every declared element resolves to its own stable object and replacement path.

failures.symptom: Pink desktop or neighboring surface pixels travel with a label, thumb, checkbox, or window.
failures.remediation: Regenerate or difference-isolate the foreground against its Clean Plate; never accept a raw rectangular crop.
failures.acceptance_gate: The declared negative-space ring is transparent and moving the element reveals no donor background.

failures.symptom: The visible interior matches while a box seam, clipped glyph, or stray neighboring pixel remains at the perimeter.
failures.remediation: Widen the oracle beyond the opaque interior and re-isolate from the correct source origin.
failures.acceptance_gate: Interior, perimeter, and required clear rows and columns all satisfy their local contracts.

failures.symptom: Removing donor pixels deletes the stepped rounded window chrome or replaces it with a hard rectangular edge.
detectors: high-zoom source and runtime corner crops
failures.remediation: Remove only donor-colored pixels, retain non-donor border pixels, and reconstruct the source's stepped pixel corner mask.
failures.acceptance_gate: Every corner preserves the declared transparent steps and opaque source border without magenta contamination.

failures.symptom: Japanese text escapes its source region, overlaps a checkbox, or uses an incompatible smooth font.
failures.remediation: Use source-locked raster Exact Copy where needed or the shared pixel font inside fixed source geometry.
failures.acceptance_gate: Every text range is contained, non-overlapping, verbatim Japanese, and uses its declared font authority.

failures.symptom: A visible option pixel activates info, or overlapping artwork gives two controls ownership of the same coordinate.
failures.remediation: Separate non-interactive visual overlap from adjacent transparent input regions with one explicit boundary owner.
failures.acceptance_gate: Every interactive pixel maps to exactly one intended control and both sides of each boundary are tested.

failures.symptom: A native range thumb stops short of the source track endpoint or carries a grey rectangular donor crop.
failures.remediation: Keep the semantic range input but hide its browser thumb and derive an independent visual thumb from declared endpoints.
failures.acceptance_gate: The visual center equals both source endpoints and the source-delta thumb has transparent negative space.

failures.symptom: A slider or minimize transition jumps through four frames and looks choppy.
detectors: distinct value or geometry sample count
failures.remediation: Implement continuous numeric behavior or a declared stepped-smooth duration rather than a raster-state slideshow.
failures.acceptance_gate: Continuous controls emit more than four values; transitions meet the declared sample and interruption contract.

failures.symptom: Minimize simply clips the existing UI instead of revealing a coherent newly generated surface.
detectors: endpoint difference from equivalent source crop
failures.remediation: Run a bounded Qwen Image 3 Pro endpoint Render Pass and keep its prompt, provider, seed, and selected output.
failures.acceptance_gate: The endpoint differs materially from a crop, has provenance, and contains no hidden body pixels.

failures.symptom: A visible button, selector, checkbox, or menu can be pressed but has no observable settled effect.
failures.remediation: Add the missing Behavior Contract or explicitly disable and explain the control; never leave an enabled dead surface.
failures.acceptance_gate: Every enabled control has pointer-down feedback and a tested settled state transition.

failures.symptom: Dragging or minimizing moves content beyond the viewport or clips part of the window.
failures.remediation: Constrain the complete window rectangle to its desktop host using current dimensions at every motion frame.
failures.acceptance_gate: Every window remains recoverable and its title controls stay reachable after extreme drags and state changes.

failures.symptom: Figma auto-layout repositions a newly appended hotspot or asset despite requested coordinates.
failures.remediation: Set absolute layout positioning after reparenting, then write coordinates and read them back.
failures.acceptance_gate: Hosted node geometry equals the manifest after the final parent relationship is established.

failures.symptom: The browser works but Figma links differ, or Figma looks correct while continuous behavior is absent.
failures.remediation: Keep editable Design and Executable Prototype as separate authorities tied by versioned state and geometry contracts.
failures.acceptance_gate: Both audits pass independently and parity fields match; neither layer infers the other's verdict.

failures.symptom: A required Qwen pass silently falls back to another model or loses reference conditioning.
detectors: reference hash and prompt ID verification
failures.remediation: Fail closed unless the model is qwen/qwen-image-3-pro and the approved provider/ref inputs are recorded.
failures.acceptance_gate: Every generative asset names the exact Qwen model, provider, reference hash, prompt, seed, and selection decision.

failures.symptom: A related board or worktree is mistaken for the authoritative Japanese screenshot.
detectors: file key and node ID check
failures.remediation: Resolve the immutable Reference Screen identity before any Render Pass or Figma write.
failures.acceptance_gate: All manifests and evidence resolve to the same approved file key, node ID, dimensions, and hash.

failures.symptom: A full-frame Qwen revision improves one element while rewriting text, layout, or unrelated chrome.
failures.remediation: Use one bounded Asset Pass per change and deterministic Assembly; reject whole-image feedback chaining.
failures.acceptance_gate: Unchanged regions have zero difference where required and every changed region is declared.

failures.symptom: Screenshots pass while pointer-down, animation, menu reachability, or complete user journeys fail.
failures.remediation: Layer component tests, browser gestures, temporal sampling, visual regions, and exploratory scouting.
failures.acceptance_gate: Every critical flow is replayed through user inputs with retained failure traces and no console errors.
